notes: Adversarial bound cases are declared-field-only: the runner MUST judge them from the envelope's declared segment_bytes / segment_count / size_bytes values before deriving keys or downloading any segment, and MUST NOT materialise multi-MiB plaintext or ciphertext to exercise them.

cases.name: stream_aead_roundtrip
assertions: multi-segment plaintext with a short final segment decrypts byte-for-byte
incremental segment verification accepts only ascending segment indices
ciphertext_digest is recomputed over the concatenated ciphertext and mismatches fail with digest_mismatch

cases.name: stream_aead_truncation_rejected
assertions: dropping the final legal segment fails finish with segment_stream_truncated
declared segment_count must equal ceil(size_bytes / segment_bytes)
count mismatches are rejected before a stream can be completed

cases.name: stream_aead_reorder_rejected
assertions: no deterministic reordering or replay recovery is attempted

cases.name: stream_aead_scheme_closure
assertions: unknown stream attachment schemes fail closed with unsupported_attachment_scheme
envelopes carrying both nonce and nonce_prefix/segment_* fields fail encrypted_attachment oneOf validation

cases.name: stream_aead_bounds_rejected

expected.rule: segment_count MUST equal ceil(size_bytes / segment_bytes); declared 4 but ceil(2621440 / 262144) = 10

assertions: declared segment_count above 2^20 fails closed with segment_bounds_invalid before any key derivation or segment download
declared segment_bytes below 1024 or above 8388608 fails blob.schema.json#/$defs/encrypted_attachment bounds and is rejected with segment_bounds_invalid
declared segment_count inconsistent with ceil(size_bytes / segment_bytes) fails closed with segment_bounds_invalid
receivers never preallocate buffers or download plans from unvalidated declared bounds; cases are judged on declared fields only, no multi-MiB payload is materialised
